behavior.pointer: Only the eye pixels extracted from the approved canonical artwork move. The body, props, background and layout remain fixed.
behavior.welcome: The approved canonical artwork remains visible. A brief eye blink is used instead of swapping the mascot pose.
behavior.loading: The original eye layer changes brightness and opacity only.
behavior.success: The same canonical mascot remains visible. Eye emphasis and a success badge are added without replacing the artwork.

notes: Reference-only mascot assets must not be imported into the login Hero.
Changing the canonical artwork or its hash requires explicit design approval and a mascot-lock.json update.
The login runtime must not use pose swaps, detached limbs, generated wave frames or background parallax.
